newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: News appoints new editor to The Australian.
newsitem.headline: News appoints new editor to The Australian.

text.p: News Ltd, the Australian arm of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, said on Tuesday it has appointed Campbell Reid, the assistant editor of local daily The Daily Telegraph, as editor of its national daily The Australian.
The appointment follows the resignation on Monday of Malcolm Schmidtke, who had held the post since 1995.

News Ltd executive chairman Lachlan Murdoch also announced that Jeni Cooper, currently managing editor of The Australian, had been appointed assistant editor, news, of Sunday publication The Sunday Telegraph.
